title: Phase 1.5: enforce ADR-0023 execution budgets
summary: Correct the frozen Phase 1.5 provider contract under approved ADR-0023 by adding one immutable execution-budget lineage and authoritative ledger per authorized execution.

Atomically reserve one model-generation branch and its cumulative output allowance before direct provider invocation, persist failure-safe settlement evidence, and derive run telemetry from ledger state.

Certify the exact Claude Messages HTTP and OpenAI Responses HTTP paths; fail Codex CLI closed before subprocess execution because its multiplicity, retries, cumulative cap, and settlement remain opaque.
risk: Medium: this is a security-relevant frozen-contract correction at the live provider boundary, with conservative charging on uncertainty and fail-closed behavior on unprovable transports.
No provider, routing, role-budget, gateway, harness, deployment, release, business-runtime, or product capability is added.
testEvidence: The adversarial execution-budget suite covers lineage continuity, exact maxTurns mapping, atomic/concurrent admission, retries, provider switch, model re-entry, fan-out, streaming-style settlement, invalid/missing usage, duplicate settlement, violations, recovery, and projections.
Exact adapter-plus-transport fixtures prove one HTTP generation, hard provider caps, reasoning-inclusive OpenAI usage, conservative failures, and Codex CLI rejection before subprocess execution.
The authoritative npm run ci:prepublish result is bound to the final candidate tree and appended to the published draft PR body; GitHub independently reruns protected checks on the exact head.
documentationImpact: Update only canonical Phase 1.5 current-state, completion-audit, observability, README, generated indexes, and bounded conformance attestation material required by ADR-0023.
Approved ADR-0023 remains byte-for-byte unchanged; PR #74 and PR #76 are untouched.
rollback: Revert this bounded correction through the protected pull-request workflow before any direct provider path is re-enabled without the ADR-0023 contract.
No database, queue, cloud service, deployment topology, provider credential, production data, or irreversible migration is introduced.
